paper_title: Searching for Low-Mass Axions using Resonant Upconversion
notes: UPLOAD (UPconversion Low-Noise Oscillator Axion Detection) room-temperature resonant AC haloscope. Measured 95% CL exclusion of axions with mass 1.12-1.20 ueV (271.7-290.3 MHz beat frequency) above g_agamma (and equivalently g_aBB) of 3e-6 GeV^-1, from 30 days of power-technique data. Encoded as a flat bound over the stated mass range using the abstract's quoted coupling value; the actual exclusion curve (Fig. 7) has some frequency dependence not tabulated in text. The same numerical limit applies to the QEMD coupling g_aBB. Paper assumes standard virialized halo DM (v_rms = 226 km/s) but does not state a numerical local density, so dm_density_assumed left null. A projection for a future cryogenic niobium setup is also shown (blue dashed line in Fig. 7) but the primary result is the measured limit. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.75, 2))
